credit: 3D models by Ubiquiti Inc., from the UniFi store product pages.
note: The rack mountable subset of Ubiquiti's published product models, chosen by measured geometry rather than by name. A device qualifies if its Y axis is a near multiple of 44.45mm and one horizontal axis measures 442.4mm. Rack units and the viewer's yaw both fall out of that measurement.
